Welcome! We are currently discussing whether our baseline definition for the **Bullwhip Effect** fully captures all relevant drivers.

**Open questions for discussion:**

- Should we explicitly mention inventory management policies alongside forecasting updates?
- Would it be more accurate to refine "demand distortions" into "distortions in the perception of demand"?

**What is your perspective?** Feel free to reply below or propose an update to the definition!
